```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/helpers.R")
lab_email <- "petya.apostolova@unibas.ch"

# Mailto button with a pre-filled subject line
apply_button <- function(position) {
  a(class = "btn-solid",
    href = paste0("mailto:", lab_email, "?subject=",
                  utils::URLencode(paste("Application:", position), reserved = TRUE)),
    "Apply by email")
}
```

# Openings {.page-title}

::: {.center .lead-text}

-  [**Research Assistant/Lab Technician Position in Blood Cancer Biology and Immunotherapy (70-100%)**](https://jobs.unibas.ch/offene-stellen/research-assistant-lab-technician-position-in-blood-cancer-biology-and-immunotherapy/ae052bac-c915-4391-86ea-ffa847ae9ba9), starting 1.
